description: VMP api-node — Deno Deploy via linked GitHub repository; Postgres via DATABASE_URL.
notes: Deno Deploy builds from the linked repo on every push (PR previews and production on main). Keep packages/api-node/deno.json deploy block as org/app only so dashboard install/build/runtime stay in effect (source install/build/runtime overrides the dashboard). Bundle via scripts/build.mjs (createRequire banner + workspace aliases). Optional lean installer: scripts/deno-deploy-install.mjs. PR gate: npm run verify:api-node in ci.yml. Deploy gate: Deno Deploy build status on the PR.
